entities.summary: Dominique Malonga is a French professional basketball player for the Seattle Storm of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for the Breeze of Unrivaled. She was selected second overall by the Storm in the 2025 WNBA draft. She also plays for the France national basketball team. She was the youngest member of the team at the 2024 Summer Olympics and won a silver medal.
